thesis.infer: Price, OI and sentiment are rising together while funding stays near its floor, so we read this as new longs adding without crowded carry. Consensus is pricing a hold on Oct 28; we read the risk as a hawkish surprise given oil above $100 and a hot CPI print reported by secondary sources. The disagreement: crypto bounces while equities' growth leg and semis fade and stablecoin supply contracts, which risk skews toward a fragile bounce.
thesis.forecast: Base case (we lean here, low-confidence): BTC holds above the ETF cost basis ($81.7K) into the Oct 28 FOMC; a daily close below $81.7K breaks it and is hl-cycles' stated invalidation. Tail case (low-confidence): a daily close below the True Market Mean ($79.2K) could put the STH cost basis ($74.4K) in play. Second tail case (low-confidence): a dovish hold with oil under $100 may let stablecoin supply recover and support a move toward the Mean MVRV price ($105.6K, far overhead).
